title: The problem is with the AI Studio service

updates.body: We noticed a partial unavailability of the AI Studio service in the Cloud. There may be 503 errors when working through the web console or API. The developers are already aware of it and are fixing it.
At 09:51 Moscow time, the problem was fixed, and now the Cloud services are working correctly. We are investigating the causes of its occurrence.

title: Problems getting a list of models in the AI Studio service

updates.body: We noticed that the API does not return the correct list of available models. The developers are already aware and are fixing it.
At 6:21 p.m., the problem was resolved. If you still have questions about cloud resources, please contact technical support.

An error was found in calculating charges for some of the resources.
Billing processing has been temporarily stopped to prevent incorrect charges.
After the cause is eliminated, the necessary accrual adjustments will be made.
No additional user actions are required.

The team is engaged in unblocking previously stopped resources. As soon as availability is restored, users will need to manually launch these resources. We will inform you about the completion of the process additionally.

Most of the clouds that were mistakenly blocked earlier have already been restored, and users will need to manually start the stopped resources themselves. The team is also working on unblocking mistakenly blocked billing accounts and displaying the details correctly; we expect the details to start displaying correctly by the end of the day.

All cloud accounts and billing accounts that were mistakenly blocked have now been unblocked. We ask users to manually restart any resources that should be active.
